sentence: This project tests whether genetic disorders can be diagnosed early in pregnancy so that more treatment options are available.
This project studies how blood vessels can be regrown to help damaged salivary glands repair themselves.
This project studies how genomic non-coding variants and somatic copy number variants add to the causes of Tourette Syndrome.
This project tries to help people with a major lower limb amputation walk better, get hurt less and wear a prosthesis in comfort.
This project studies whether a transcription factor in astrocyte cells is needed for Alzheimer's disease to start and progress.
This project builds a tissue bank and cell maps of healthy and diseased kidney samples from children to help find targets for treatment.
This project offers metabolomics assays and helps with study design and data analysis for diabetes research.
This project builds image reconstruction and motion correction methods that improve the quality of positron emission tomography images.
This project tries to find out how cardiovascular disease and genetic factors relate to amyloid beta, a biomarker of Alzheimer's disease, in Down syndrome.
This project uses a directional lead to map the electrophysiology of the globus pallidus interna and subthalamic nucleus in patients with Parkinson's disease.
This project studies how targeting molecules on the surface of lentivirus-like particles can deliver genome editing enzymes to hematopoietic stem cells.
This project studies how a tumor-promoting gene makes prostate cancers resist therapy and whether a drug blocking its gene products kills the cancer cells.
This project develops antiviral therapeutics against RNA viruses, including flavi- and hemorrhagic fever viruses.
This project studies how improving metabolic health changes microbial and metabolomic features of the oral ecosystem in patients with Metabolic Syndrome.
This project uses microscopic and computational methods to study how DNA is repaired after damage and where cancer cells are vulnerable.
This project studies how two proteins interact to switch on DNA sensing and how this is controlled in cancer.
This project studies how a candidate regulator adds to secondary tissue damage after traumatic spinal cord injury.
This project builds statistical and computational methods to study how evolutionary processes shape the genome and how genetic variation affects traits.
This project builds a liquid biopsy biomarker that finds resistance early in patients with metastatic prostate cancer.
